entries.text: 我是熱血沸騰的凰檗！\n我們來一同燃燒鬥志吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_first_01

entries.text: 嘿呀！轉學生！\n是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳叫我來的對吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_00

entries.text: 能夠在新的職場挑戰，\n我現在是激昂不已啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_01

entries.text: 我會被叫到這裡來，\n想必是有原因的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳希望從我這裡\n得到什麼呢！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_03

entries.text: 熱血精神
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 知識
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 只是希望有妳在這裡
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_select_03

entries.text: 哦哦！那我可擅長了！\c\n就用我的熱血來讓藍莓學園\n火熱沸騰吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04

entries.text:
哦哦！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是對我的
對戰學知識有所期待啊！\c
不愧是相當注重
寶可夢對戰的學園！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04b

entries.text: 那是什麼怪答案！\n轉學生，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳怎麼了！？\r\n果然是在謳歌青春嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_04c

entries.text: 不論如何，一切都包在\n熱血沸騰的凰檗我身上就對了！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就當自己是掛在鐵掌力士的肩膀上，\n儘管放心吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp01_06

entries.text: 轉學生！\n生態巨蛋真是棒啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_00

entries.text: 我的心得是！\n巨蛋就相當於學院的操場！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_01

entries.text: 非常寬敞舒暢，\n是鍛鍊腳力的最佳場所！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_02

entries.text: 下堂課我打算來個實習課，\n和大家繞巨蛋跑一圈鍛鍊腳力，\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳覺得怎麼樣？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_03

entries.text: 不錯耶！
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 聽起來有點……
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 嗯！鍛鍊好腰腿，\n一定是有百利而無一害的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_04

entries.text: 果然是做過頭了嗎？\n看來只是我自己想去跑啊！\c\n真沒辦法……那就減成半圈吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_04b

entries.text: 當然我也會要[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n一起來體驗的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp02_05

entries.text: 這個學園的學生們，\n個個都滿是幹勁啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_00

entries.text: 來上對戰學的學生們，\n他們的專注力真不是蓋的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_01

entries.text: 聽說這個學園的課程，\n越是與對戰有關連，\r\n成績的配分比例就越高呢！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_02

entries.text: 畢竟如果擅長寶可夢對戰，\n那要當聯盟職員、加入巡護員部隊\r\n或要成為專業的訓練家，都是有希望的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_03

entries.text: 滿滿的夢想呢！
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 真的嗎！？
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 當然，還可以夢想成為\n像我這樣的對戰學老師呢！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_04

entries.text: 唔唔！[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是第一次聽說嗎！？\c\n在不知道的狀況下就當上冠軍，\n可見[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是打從心底地喜歡寶可夢呢！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_04b

entries.text: 不論是對戰學，還是其他事情，\n只要努力去學習，\r\n選項就會無止盡地增加！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_05

entries.text: 但願[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能不斷地學習，\n別到了將來才悔不當初喔，轉學生！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_sp03_06

entries.text: ……有種像是\n在對[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說教的感覺呢！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_00

entries.text: 不管是作為老師還是戰友，\n我都很在意[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢。[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_01

entries.text: 為了加深彼此的交情，\n我們要不要來交換個寶可夢！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_02

entries.text: 好！那我們開始吧！\n我打算選瑪沙那！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳要選哪個孩子呢？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳選[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊！
牠很有嘿呀的味道，真棒！\c
我會每天和牠一起鍛鍊，
讓牠強到破表！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_01_04

entries.text: 那麼轉學生[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n就和我的瑪沙那交換囉！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_00

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_02_03

entries.text:
同行寶可夢只有１隻的話，
是不能交換的！\c
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳先去讓同行寶可夢有２隻以上，
再來找我嘿呀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_03_00

entries.text: 要下次再說嗎？\n等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想嘿呀了，再來告訴我吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_03_01

entries.text: 嘿呀！轉學生！\c\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打算要和我交換寶可夢了嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_trade_04_00

entries.text: 嘿呀！轉學生！\c\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是在邀我寶可夢對戰嗎！？[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_talkto_00

entries.text: 唔唔！不是啊……\n要對戰的話，我隨時奉陪！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_cancel_00

entries.text: 我沒有理由拒絕！\n我們用跑的去對戰場吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 真不甘心……！\n我又徹底被打敗了……！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 但我的收穫也很大！\n我要把經驗化為己用，在下次打贏[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 我也受轉學生[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳照顧了！\n收下我的心意吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 一口喝光攻擊增強劑後，\n就讓我們向著夕陽嘿呀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 62]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_reward_00

entries.text: 今天的對戰也棒極了！\n轉學生！謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 別以為下次也能這樣！\n讓我們向著夕陽嘿呀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
這次是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳讓我贏的！
我保住對戰學老師的面子了！\c
戰敗的不甘心，
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳就望著大海，吞進肚裡吧！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 聯盟社的社辦\n擠滿了年輕人，\r\n簡直是青春大塞車啊！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
坦白說，
我不喜歡坐飛機……\c
所以來藍莓學園對我來說，
是非常需要振作起氣勢的一件事。[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
在對戰進行時，
也是能鍛鍊身體的！\c
下次對戰時看看我的動作吧！
我就是靠那個來提升心肺功能的！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
轉學生[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
今天也是活力滿分！\c
我做的三明治牠也都
吃得津津有味喔！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_battle_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我交換給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的瑪沙那最近如何！？
那孩子是拳擊高手！\c
不管敵人有多強，牠都會用
各式各樣的拳技將對手擊個粉碎喔！[VAR 0x0114(0024)]
